a: Postdoc $73,000-$75,000/yr or associate research scholar $75,000-$83,000/yr, plus annual research fund; up to 3 years
dt: Full consideration for applications and letters received by Nov 1, 2026; applications accepted until filled
e: Fellowship for early-career scientists to do independent or collaborative research in physics broadly (including astrophysics, biophysics, geophysics and planetary physics) at Princeton, starting around Sep 1, 2027; commitment to broadening participation is encouraged. PhD in the physical sciences or a related field required; no citizenship restriction stated, but the ad says it cannot sponsor H-1B visas that require consular processing.
n: Princeton University: Future Faculty in the Physical Sciences (FFPS) Postdoctoral Fellowship
unv: Also posted on INSPIRE (3212699) with an Interfolio application link; not eligible for H-1B sponsorship requiring consular processing per the AJO ad.
